title: 第25章 关外最美女天师第26章 你踏马吹牛逼呢
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: 并且这七八个武清观的弟子中，有两个辈分不低。
作为关外第一道观，实力第一，规模第一，武清观是非常专业的。
他们的道服上会根据弟子辈分，在袖口，领口用银线绣制云纹。
就有点像是军人的肩章。
像是在宁远镇见过的那一队武清观弟子，那为首的大师兄黄冠闵，袖口跟领口便是一道云纹。
而那有点儿吵，伶牙俐齿的小师妹也是一道云纹。
一道云纹便是武清观的当代弟子。
而两道云纹者，实力与品行优秀者，便可开门收徒！
再往上便是三道，四道，最高六道金云纹。
武清观的这个辈分，并非是只根据武清观自己内部划分，是根据整个关外的修道者辈分。
要说起来，按照这个辈分划分，陆远算是四道云纹。
没错，陆远的辈分很高。
主要是家里老头子辈分高，陆远是老头子的亲传弟子，辈分自然高的不行。
不过也没啥用，这玩意儿在外面不是一个道观的，也没啥人认这个。
也就是在一些个道家大典，大会上，才会按资排辈。
此时在陈福顺身后的这群武清观弟子，有两个是两道云纹。
之前那个武清观的大师兄黄冠闵到了这儿，得管这二道云纹的叫师叔。
虽说这云纹并不代表实力，但绝大多数情况下，辈分高的要比辈分低的实力高。
这帮人出现在这儿……
有了上次的事情，陆远心里有点KFC了。
所以，也根本不去问这帮人为什么会在这儿，只是微微躬身拱手道：
“道长慈悲。”
这几个武清观的道士，第一时间倒也立即回礼。
但那眼神中，却全是审视。
把陆远从头到脚审视一遍。
不是之前黄冠闵那种瞧不起的眼神，而是一种……
“就你小子叫陆远啊！”
就基本上是这种感觉。
这给陆远弄的有点莫名其妙，但陆远也不问这些武清观的道士，而是转头望向陈福顺直接道：
“村长，武清观的道长怎么……”
陆远的话只说了一半，就被陈福顺一个急促的摆手打断。
陈福顺凑近一步，压低了声音，语气里满是撇清关系的急切。
“他们自己来的，我们可没请！”
“说是刚从太阴山里出来，顺路，非要留下看看……我撵了几次了，不走。”
武清观的道士：“……”
你要不声音再小点呢？
我们全听见了！！
content_en:
And among the seven or eight Wu Qingguan disciples, two were of high seniority.
As the first Taoist temple outside the customs, first in strength and first in scale, Wuqing Temple is very professional.
Their Taoist uniforms will have cloud patterns embroidered with silver thread on the cuffs and collar according to the seniority of the disciples.
It's a bit like a military epaulette.
For example, the group of Wu Qingguan disciples I saw in Ningyuan Town, led by Senior Brother Huang Guanmin, had a cloud pattern on his sleeves and collar.
And the little junior sister who is a bit noisy and sharp-tongued is also a moire.
A cloud pattern is a contemporary disciple of Wu Qingguan.
And those with two cloud patterns, those with excellent strength and conduct, can open the door to accept disciples!
Further up are three, four, and the highest six golden cloud patterns.
The seniority of Wu Qing Guan is not only based on the internal division of Wu Qing Guan itself, but also based on the seniority of the entire cultivator outside the custom.
To put it bluntly, according to this generation classification, Lu Yuan can be regarded as four moirés.
Yes, Lu Yuan is of high seniority.
The main reason is that the old man in the family has a high seniority. Lu Yuan is the old man's direct disciple, so his seniority is naturally very high.
But it’s useless. This thing is not a Taoist temple outside, and few people recognize it.
That is to say, in some Taoist ceremonies and conferences, seniority is ranked according to seniority.
At this time, two of the group of Wu Qingguan disciples behind Chen Fushun had two cloud patterns.
When Huang Guanmin, the senior senior brother of Wu Qingguan, came here, the one who had to take care of these two cloud patterns was called his uncle.
Although this moiré pattern does not represent strength, in most cases, those with higher seniority are stronger than those with lower seniority.
These guys show up here...
Hmm...
After what happened last time, Lu Yuan felt a little bit KFC in his heart.
Therefore, I didn’t ask why these people were here at all, I just bowed slightly and cupped my hands and said:
"Taoist Master is compassionate."
These Taoist priests from Wuqingguan immediately returned the greeting.
But those eyes were full of scrutiny.
Look at Lu Yuan from head to toe.
It's not Huang Guanmin's disdainful look before, but a kind of...
"Your name is Lu Yuan!"
That's basically what it feels like.
This made Lu Yuan a little confused, but Lu Yuan did not ask these Taoist priests from Wu Qingguan, but turned to look at Chen Fushun and said directly:
"Village chief, what about the Taoist priest of Wu Qingguan..."
Lu Yuan was only halfway through what he said when he was interrupted by Chen Fushun's hasty wave of his hand.
Chen Fushun took a step closer and lowered his voice, his tone full of eagerness to clear up the relationship.
"They came by themselves, we didn't invite them!"
"He said he just came out of Taiyin Mountain. He was on the way, and he insisted on staying and taking a look...I have chased him away several times and he won't leave."
Taoist priest from Wu Qingguan: "..."
Why don't you lower your voice?
We heard it all! !
